changelog: The Config Files page now includes a link to the Owner Support Guide: it explains what each on-screen message means, what you can safely do yourself, and how to get help from an AI assistant -- including how to set up your own automations, dashboards and phone notifications using the Comfort entities. Nothing about the alarm or your settings changes.
details: v53a (BENCH ROUND -- local commits only, nothing pushed; the docs themselves are already public on main at 8e09c9f). Owner Support Guide link on the Config Files page. (1) dashboards/system.yaml: the Remote Support Access card gains an 'Owner Support Guide' paragraph linking to https://github.com/slychiu/ComfortHA-yaml/blob/main/SUPPORT.md -- the guide is a public-repo document, not updater-deployed, so only the link ships in this release. The target guide was expanded in the same main-line commit: section 9 'Doing more with your system' now teaches the owner to ask an AI assistant (paste-able prompt carrying the alarm entity, arm scripts, zone binary sensors, bypass controls and battery sensors) to build automations and their own dashboards, and restates the safety rules (do not edit the Cytech pages, .storage or the shipped automations; never give an assistant the remote link, login or PIN). (2) packages/cytech.yaml: comment-only bump so cytech_update.sh's auto-restart trigger fires -- without it a dashboards/system.yaml-only change would not restart Core, and the YAML-mode dashboard would keep rendering the old page. Offline verification: both YAML files parse (pyyaml, UTF-8); the link is present in system.yaml. Bench verification: PASSED on cytech.local 2026-10-17 via the real owner flow -- Check -> Update Now called through the Supervisor core-proxy service (the same shell_command the buttons call), serving the tag's blobs from a local mirror. v52 -> v53a, 27/27 files applied, Core auto-restarted, pending cleared. Deployed files byte-identical to the committed blobs (dashboards/system.yaml 1a2e36c5652c8eb7caf7faee803ced16, packages/cytech.yaml 65f10129ad2a6a4077ef348ff10c7b91); the new Owner Support Guide paragraph and link are present on the device; the post-restart 4-hourly network check ran normally. Teardown: secrets backup at .cytech_secrets.pre_53a; the bench stays on the mirror for the owner preview and is restored to the fleet URL at promotion.
